declarations.name: RetryMiddleware
declarations.doc: A middleware that retries model and tool requests on failure.

constructors.doc: Creates a RetryMiddleware.

members.name: maxRetries
members.doc: The maximum number of retry attempts.

members.name: statuses
members.doc: The list of status codes that should trigger a retry.

members.name: initialDelay
members.doc: The delay before the first retry. Later retries multiply it by backoffFactor.

members.name: maxDelay
members.doc: The upper bound on the backoff delay.

members.name: backoffFactor
members.doc: The factor by which the delay increases with each retry.

members.name: noJitter
members.doc: Whether to disable jitter. Jitter is enabled by default.

members.name: onError
members.doc: An optional callback that is called on each error.

members.name: noRetryModel
members.doc: Whether to skip retrying model requests (e.g. to retry only tools). Model requests are retried by default.

members.name: retryTools
members.doc: Whether to retry tool requests. Defaults to `false`.

members.name: defaultRetryStatuses
members.doc: The default list of status codes that trigger a retry.

members.name: defaultInitialDelay
members.doc: The default initialDelay.

members.name: defaultMaxDelay
members.doc: The default maxDelay.
